scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Destitute Children Scheme
other_conditions: Child must be deprived of parental support due to the death of a parent
Child must be deprived of parental support due to the father’s continuous absence from home for the last 2 years
Child must be deprived of parental support because a parent has been sentenced to imprisonment for at least one year
Child must be deprived of parental support due to the physical or mental incapacity of a parent
Maximum assistance is limited to two children per family
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1850 per month per child, up to two children per family.
